title: Filemon 1:1
content: 1 Bulus, ɗan kurkuku saboda Kiristi Yesu, da kuma Timoti ɗan’uwanmu, Zuwa ga Filemon ƙaunataccen abokinmu da kuma abokin aikinmu,

title: Filemon 1:2
content: 2 zuwa kuma ga Affiya ’yar’uwarmu, zuwa kuma ga Arkiffus abokin famarmu, da zuwa kuma ga ikkilisiyar da take taruwa a gidanka.

title: Filemon 1:3
content: 3 Alheri da salama daga Allah Ubanmu da kuma Ubangiji Yesu Kiristi, su kasance tare da ku.

title: Filemon 1:4
content: 4 Kullum nakan gode wa Allahna sa’ad da nake tuna da kai cikin addu’o’ina,

title: Filemon 1:5
content: 5 domin ina jin labari bangaskiyarka cikin Ubangiji Yesu da kuma ƙaunarka da kake yi saboda dukan tsarkaka.

title: Filemon 1:6
content: 6 Ina addu’a ka zama mai ƙwazo cikin shaida bangaskiyarka, domin ka sami cikakken fahimta ta kowane abin da yake nagarin da muke da shi cikin Kiristi.

title: Filemon 1:7
content: 7 Ƙaunarka ta sa ni farin ciki ƙwarai ta kuma ƙarfafa ni, domin kai, ɗan’uwa, ka wartsake zukatan tsarkaka.

title: Filemon 1:8
content: 8 Saboda haka, ko da yake cikin Kiristi ina iya yin ƙarfin hali in umarce ka ka yi abin da ya kamata,

title: Filemon 1:9
content: 9 duk da haka ina roƙonka saboda ƙauna, na fi so in roƙe ka, ni Bulus tsoho, a yanzu kuma ga ni ɗan sarƙa saboda Kiristi Yesu.

title: Filemon 1:10
content: 10 Ina roƙonka saboda ɗana Onesimus, wanda ya zama ɗana yayinda nake cikin sarƙoƙi.

title: Filemon 1:11
content: 11 Dā kam, ba shi da amfani a gare ka, amma yanzu ya zama da amfani a gare ka da kuma gare ni.

title: Filemon 1:12
content: 12 Ina aike shi yă koma gare ka, shi da yake zuciyata.

title: Filemon 1:13
content: 13 Na so in riƙe shi a wurina a madadinka domin yă taimake ni yayinda nake cikin sarƙoƙi saboda bishara.

title: Filemon 1:14
content: 14 Sai dai ban so in yi kome ban da yardarka ba, domin kowane alherin da za ka yi, yă fito daga zuciyarka, ba na tilas ba.

title: Filemon 1:15
content: 15 Wataƙila abin da ya sa aka raba ka da shi na ɗan lokaci ƙanƙani shi ne don ka same shi da amfani

title: Filemon 1:16
content: 16 ba kamar bawa kuma ba, sai dai fiye da bawa, a matsayin ƙaunataccen ɗan’uwa. Shi ƙaunatacce ne sosai a gare ni amma a gare ka ya ma fi zama ƙaunatacce, kamar mutum da kuma kamar ɗan’uwa a cikin Ubangiji.

title: Filemon 1:17
content: 17 Saboda haka in ka ɗauke ni a kan ni abokin tarayya ne, sai ka marabce shi kamar yadda za ka marabce ni.

title: Filemon 1:18
content: 18 In ya yi maka wani laifi ko kuma yana riƙe maka wani bashi, sai ka mai da shi a kaina.

title: Filemon 1:19
content: 19 Ni, Bulus, nake rubuta wannan da hannuna. Zan biya ka, kada ma a yi zancen ranka da kake riƙe mini bashi.

title: Filemon 1:20
content: 20 Ina fata, ɗan’uwa, zan sami amfani daga gare ka cikin Ubangiji; ka wartsake zuciyata cikin Kiristi.

title: Filemon 1:21
content: 21 Da tabbacin biyayyarka, ina rubuta maka, da sanin za ka yi fiye da abin da na ce.

title: Filemon 1:22
content: 22 Abu guda ya rage, ka shirya mini masauƙi, domin ina bege za a mayar da ni gare ku albarkacin addu’o’inku.

title: Filemon 1:23
content: 23 Efafaras, abokin tarayyata a kurkuku cikin Kiristi Yesu, yana gaishe ka.

title: Filemon 1:24
content: 24 Haka kuma Markus, Aristarkus, Demas da kuma Luka, abokan aikina.

title: Filemon 1:25
content: 25 Alherin Ubangiji Yesu Kiristi yă kasance da ruhunku.
